note: Hand-written guidance. Re-verify menu paths before a public demo.

google.label: Google
export_guide: Deselect all, then select My Activity and Location History.
Choose JSON and create the export.
Download the ZIP to this computer and drop it here.

location.label: Location history
location.why: Reveals where you live, work, travel, and when you are away.
steps: Open Web & App Activity and Location History.
Turn on auto-delete and delete older history.

activity.label: Search and activity history
activity.why: Search terms can reveal health, money, relationships, plans, and private interests.
steps: Filter sensitive activity and delete matching items.
Turn on auto-delete for future activity.

sensitive_steps: Review and delete the sensitive searches shown by TRACE.
Turn on auto-delete for future activity.

spotify.label: Spotify
export_guide: Download the ZIP when Spotify emails you.
Drop it here for local analysis.

activity.label: Listening history
activity.why: Listening history can reveal routines, mood, language, culture, and sensitive interests.
steps: Turn off tailored ads under Privacy Settings.
Review connected apps and remove ones you do not use.

sensitive_steps: Review sensitive artists, podcasts, or searches in the export.
Turn off tailored ads in Spotify Privacy Settings.

instagram.label: Instagram
sensitive_steps: Open Accounts Center and review Download your information.
Turn off contact syncing and review ad preferences.

amazon.label: Amazon
sensitive_steps: Review browsing history and personalized recommendations.

meta.label: Facebook / Meta
sensitive_steps: Open Accounts Center and review Ad preferences.
Turn off contact uploading and review connected apps.
